Programs for children & young adults

Friendship grows best in a circle that welcomes everyone.

Empower Social Circle is a warm, judgment-free space where children and young adults with special needs practice social skills, make real friends, and discover how good it feels to belong.

Join the Circle See Our Mission
Our Mission

Every child and young adult deserves a place where they're understood.

We built Empower Social Circle around one idea: friendship isn't something you're taught from a worksheet, it's something you practice, together, with people who accept you exactly as you are.

  • 1

    Everyday skills, learned through play

    Hands-on activities that build real-world abilities without ever feeling like a lesson.

  • 2

    Genuine peer connection

    Small group settings designed so kids and young adults can practice friendship, not just talk about it.

  • 3

    Inclusion as the starting point

    Every program is shaped around each participant's own strengths, not around a single standard.

  • 4

    A safe place to communicate

    Kids and young adults build confidence speaking up, listening, and connecting without fear of judgment.

  • 5

    Mentorship built into every session

    Trained mentors guide each activity, model social skills, and give every child and young adult someone extra to lean on.

  • 6

    Everyday financial literacy

    Simple, hands-on lessons on budgeting, saving, and smart money habits, built right into our activities.

Community Event

Annual Community Picnic & Back-to-School Fest

Empower Social Circle, along with Twins & Company Accessory Items and the Omicron Alpha Foundation, hosted its Annual Community Picnic & Back-to-School Fest on Saturday, August 8, at Richardson Park in Pontiac. The free event featured food, live music, games, children's activities, community resources, voter registration, and giveaways, including a backpack for every child.
